profile_text.body:
Microsoft is a public company founded in 1975 and headquartered in Redmond, WA, trading as MSFT, with CIK 0000789019. Its most recent 10-K, for the period ending 2026-06-30, reported revenue of $331,839,000,000. The company's Power Automate page describes automating workflows and business processes across apps, systems, and websites using AI, digital, and robotic process automation. The page carries customer statements, including one that validating and standardizing data to and from carriers used to take over 100 people and can now be managed by a few people with generative AI and Power Automate, and another citing a Power Platform ecosystem with generative AI and process mining capabilities.

Microsoft's tracked AI products span several areas. Microsoft Copilot is described as embedded across M365, and Azure OpenAI Service offers OpenAI models in Azure regions with enterprise content filtering, Entra ID integration, and data residency controls. Azure Machine Learning is listed as an MLOps platform with AutoML, a model registry, and responsible AI toolkit integration. Microsoft Power Automate AI covers enterprise workflow automation with Copilot integration, M365 data access, and DLP integration. Developer tools include AutoGen, a multi-agent conversation framework from Microsoft Research, Semantic Kernel, a model-agnostic orchestration SDK for .NET, Python, and Java, and Microsoft Agent Framework, described as the successor to Semantic Kernel and AutoGen with graph workflows and native MCP and A2A support. Other products are Microsoft Designer, Microsoft Teams AI, SharePoint AI, and Microsoft Clipchamp AI.

Two cases are recorded against the company, both in the U.S. District Court, S.D. New York: The New York Times Co. v. Microsoft Corp. and OpenAI, and Authors Guild v. OpenAI, Inc. Washington state is listed as the location of 114 recorded cases of law exposure.
